description.narrative: The Ruta Pacífica de las Mujeres (RPM) is a feminist movement with political action through 300 Ubia organizations in more than 140 municipalities in Colombia, including those in which the Peace Agreement between the FARC-EP and the Colombian government is being implemented. The Ruta Pacifica works for the processing of armed conflicts in Colombia from a feminism, pacifism and the positioning of women as political subjects and actors. The RPM works on political advocacy, the formation of women's organizations, knowledge innovation, and social mobilization, in order to transform patriarchal culture and contribute to a country at peace and free of violence for women and girls in both the public and private spaces.The grant will support the following priorities and specific activities:- Financing a part of the fees of the national coordination team;- Capacity building for the "School braiding knowledge and powers" training process;- National Meeting of Regional Coordinators for the Strategic Planning of actions in one of the RPM regions - Includes follow-up and monitoring processes;- National Artivist Action (national mobilization of women): preparatory workshops and mobilization day;- Consolidation of the multi-level Political Advocacy strategy of the Ruta Pacífica de las Mujeres with a view to the enforceability of women's rights to peace and a life free of violence, from a feminist, ethnic, multicultural, territorial approach and respect for diversity;- Communications strategy that enhances the actions of the RPM movement with social and political effectiveness in favor of women in their multiple diversities;- Other operational expenses such as rent, utilities, office supplies.
